mundane_explanation.surviving: HTTP 200 for non-existent class is by-design behavior when auto-schema feature is enabled. Source code shows class existence validation exists (auto_schema.go:113-115) but is conditionally bypassed when allowCreateClass=true (add.go:95). This is a legitimate Weaviate feature that automatically creates schema from incoming objects. Not a validation defect. Classification: NOT_DEFECT (by-design auto-schema feature, not a contract violation or validation absence)
